prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original GitHub README hero illustration for xhs-context / 收藏上下文.
Create a refined wide landscape editorial illustration, approximately 2.4:1, explaining how saved personal notes become evidence an AI Agent can read. Warm off-white paper background #FCF7F5, terracotta red #AD4C38 and deep terracotta #913C2B, charcoal #352A27, restrained sage accents. Beautiful tactile paper-cut and slightly isometric document objects, crisp silhouettes, soft shadows, generous whitespace, polished calm open-source product feel. Not a screenshot or realistic app interface.
Composition: a left group of three saved note cards with abstract food/travel map/code illustrations (no real content, no real usernames), leading via a thin terracotta paper ribbon into a central orderly local archive tray and a small terminal window. From there, one selected document with a highlighted paragraph is drawn toward a right-hand reading workspace with a modest geometric agent symbol, a magnifying glass and a tidy evidence card. A small open instruction booklet sits above the terminal/reading connection representing the Skill guidance. The evidence card has a small link glyph, two stacked paper layers indicating revisions, and an outlined missing-picture slot to communicate honest evidence gaps. Suggest a subtle return loop from reading toward archive for follow-up reading.
Typography: ONLY these four short labels in clean legible sans serif: "LOCAL LIBRARY" below the left group; "CLI" under central terminal; "SKILL" beside instruction booklet; "AGENT" under right group. No other letters, no numbers, no fake code or sentences. No giant title, no copied logos, no watermarks, no cloud service imagery, no shiny sci-fi AI brain. Keep all important elements within safe 6% margins. Every card's writing is abstract horizontal linework, never personal information. This image visually supports existing branding, does not invent a replacement logo.
